objective: Check whether HolyAgent's root stack and PR rules pick up a repository's own branch conventions from AGENTS.md (such as an integration branch per release that work PRs must target) and find where they would not or are ambiguous.
scope: Read the root instruction sources under /home/user/holyagent/packages/runtime/src/instructions/claude-5.5/ (root/*.md, especially version control, stack plan, PR text) and the generated /home/user/holyagent/packages/integrations/claude/dist/agents/holyagent.md, plus any runtime code that picks a PR base or branch name (holyagent vcs pr, state-mode).

Walk the case: a repository whose AGENTS.md says each release has release/<v>/integration cut from main, work PRs target it, and only it opens a PR into main. Would the root pick the integration branch as 'the base' of a delivery's first PR, name branches correctly, stack correctly, and avoid opening a work PR into main? Name each rule (file and line) that reads 'the base' as the default branch or is otherwise ambiguous.
Also list where precedence (repository mergeability and conventions vs HolyAgent defaults) is stated today, file and line.
constraints: Keep working until everything asked is done; stop to ask only when you cannot go on. When done, stop and report; name anything unrequested instead of doing it. Do not end early with a summary that announces a next step or an offer to wait. Read-only: change no files, make no git writes.
Report in under 600 words: the walk-through, then a numbered list of ambiguous or wrong rules with file:line and a one-line generic fix for each.

criteria.text: The walk-through names each rule that decides base, branch name and PR target, with file:line
Each ambiguous rule has a generic fix that hardcodes no repository's convention
